blocks.content: **Overview**: Union Budget allocated ₹2,000 crore incentive for low-value P2M UPI and RuPay debit card transactions with zero MDR. Zero MDR made effective Jan 2020.

items: **UPI, RuPay subsidy for FY27 at ₹2,000 crore** (Page 2): Union Budget allocated ₹2,000 crore incentive for low-value P2M UPI and RuPay debit card transactions with zero MDR. Zero MDR made effective Jan 2020.

**Disinvestment Target Set at ₹80,000 Crore for FY27** (Page 3): Centre set disinvestment and asset monetization target of Rs 80,000 crore for FY27 (135% higher than RE FY26 of Rs 33,837 Cr), banking on IDBI Bank and LIC.
**Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework (OOMF) by DMEO NITI Aayog** (Page 37): DMEO NITI Aayog prepares annual OOMF for all central schemes with outlay ≥₹500 Crore laid alongside Union Budget.

**Union Budget 2026-27 announces Khelo India Mission with ₹4,479.88 Crore outlay** (Page 47): Highest-ever sports budget allocation: ₹4,479.88 Cr for Sports Ministry, ₹924.35 Cr for Khelo India scheme, ₹500 Cr for sports goods manufacturing.
**Union Budget announces Integrated East Coast Industrial Corridor (Durgapur node)** (Page 59): ₹3,000 Cr allocated to NICDIT under NICDP (11 corridors under PM GatiShakti, NICDC est. 2008).
**Defence Ministry grants Miniratna-I status to YIL (Yantra India Limited)** (Page 76): YIL board empowered for capex up to ₹500 crore without government clearance.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Sovereign Macro-Fiscal Policy. Primary sovereign fiscal roadmap establishing 4.3% deficit target, ₹12.2L Cr Capex, and 536 Direct Tax sections.
